{{Quote|Unlike my esteemed colleague, I do not base my mission's success on the decibel level of the explosions.|Thorpe, on Davrill|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Thorpe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], when he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was involved in the [[Imperial Conquest Consolidation Corps]]'s efforts to crush the [[Balmorran resistance]], and disapproved of his colleague Lieutenant [[Davrill]]'s penchant for explosions.<ref name="TOR" />
